card.name: Just before parasitic worm terms
card.fires_on: Words right before an expected parasite or worm word (helminth, fluke, microfilariae, anthelmintic), in texts about worm infections and antiparasitic drugs. It fires on linking words, brackets, quotes and partial words, not on the parasite word itself.

modes.label: Partway into anthelmintic words
modes.description: Fires on the opening piece of antiparasitic drug-class words.

modes.description: Fires on small words, adjectives, quotes or brackets that lead into a worm or fluke term.
